canonical_industry_source: Must equal one of the canonical `industry` strings already governed in src/finengine/catalog.py's GROUPS industry scope_value and documented in docs/MASTER_SCHEMA.md, so a company's existing reviewed industry classification is what selects this pack -- no new classification taxonomy is introduced.
notes: sector_specific_fields is not_applicable for healthcare: catalog.py's 'healthcare' GROUPS entry only defines healthcare_operations KPI fields (beds, visits, admissions, payer mix), with no distinct sector-specific statement template comparable to banking/insurance.

licensed_beds vs operational_beds is a real, commonly conflated distinction in Saudi hospital-operator disclosures (licensed capacity vs. beds actually staffed and in service); this pack requires both as distinct fields rather than letting one silently stand in for the other, since bed_occupancy_rate is only meaningful against operational_beds.

payer_government_share / payer_insurance_share / payer_cash_share (payer mix) are recommended, not required, in this pack because several issuers disclose payer mix only qualitatively ('predominantly insurance-funded') rather than as a percentage breakdown -- forcing it to required would make the category chronically understated for otherwise well-disclosed issuers.
